items.originalTitle: Mauricio Pochettino, Manchester United'ı Premier Lig'den düşmekten kurtarabilir mi?
items.headline: Manchester United'ın yeni teknik direktörü Mauricio Pochettino, ilk maçına Pazar günü Liverpool deplasmanında çıkacak.
items.brief: Michael Carrick'in ayrılığı sonrası göreve getirilen Mauricio Pochettino, küme düşme hattında yer alan Manchester United ile ilk sınavını ezeli rakip Liverpool karşısında verecek.

Mauricio Pochettino will take charge of Manchester United for the first time on Sunday, in a trip to rivals Liverpool. x whatsapp-stroke copylink google Add Al Jazeera on Google info United States head coach Mauricio Pochettino walks off the pitch after the victory over Haiti in a Concacaf Nations League quarterfinal match at TQL Stadium on November 17 [Katie Stratman/Reuters] By Kevin Hand Published On 21 Nov 2026 21 Nov 2026 Manchester United will be led by a fourth manager in three years on Sunday when Mauricio Pochettino takes charge of his first match since replacing Michael Carrick . The fact that the Premier League clash is against their fierce rivals Liverpool – the team that, with United, are joint record English top-flight champions – is an added twist to a sordid recent tale for the Manchester club. When Sir Alex Ferguson retired after lifting a then-record 20th league title in 2013, the Red Devils had climbed to the biggest and richest club in the world. Now, apart from not being able to claim a Premier League crown since 2013, they are laden with debt – and worse still, they sit inside the relegation zone. The last time United were relegated from the top flight was in the 1973–1974 season. That came only six years after one of the club’s greatest nights – the lifting of the European Cup (now the Champions League), making them the first English club to do so. Their fall this time around has not come quite as quickly, with their last crowning as European champions in 2008, and they have not been relegated – yet. Few expect them to be. It would be unthinkable given the changed landscape of the entire footballing world, which has become awash with finances that clearly separate the elite and their resources from the rest. When Pochettino was introduced to the media for the first time on Friday, the gathered press did not mention the word “relegation” even once. So the simple answer is: yes, he can save the club from relegation. The longer equation is that the alternative would surely be the greatest shock in the history of a game famed for upsets and underdogs. Words like identity, fitness, formation, and one that Pochettino awkwardly dropped on Friday, “philosophy”, have dogged every manager at Old Trafford since Ferguson’s departure. “We arrived with the idea to create something from scratch, with our own philosophy and how we like to work,” Pochettino told the gathered reporters. “We need to improve our players, find a way to perform

analysis.question: Mauricio Pochettino'nun göreve gelmesi Manchester United'ın gidişatını nasıl etkiler?
analysis.summary: Manchester United'ın yeni teknik direktörü Mauricio Pochettino, Michael Carrick'in yerini alarak takımın başına geçti. Pochettino, ilk maçına Pazar günü Liverpool deplasmanında çıkacak. Kulüp, Sir Alex Ferguson'un 2013'teki emekliliğinden bu yana lig şampiyonluğu kazanamazken, borç yükü ve Premier Lig'de düşme hattında yer almasıyla dikkat çekiyor.

perspectives.text: Bence bu büyük kulübün düşme hattında olması, yıllarca süren plansızlığın acı bir sonucudur. Sınırda yaşarken gördüğümüz gibi, sağlam temelleri olmayan yapılar ilk büyük fırtınada sarsılır.

Asıl mesele, Pochettino'nun bu ağır borç yükü altındaki takıma kısa sürede bir kimlik kazandırıp kazandıramayacağıdır. Pazar günkü Liverpool deplasmanı, yeni teknik direktör için gerçek bir test olacak.
Büyük kulüplerin yaşadığı bu mali kriz, modern futbolun ne kadar kırılgan olduğunu gösteriyor. Kaynakların doğru yönetilmemesi, en köklü ekipleri bile düşme korkusuyla yüz yüze bırakabilir.
